Thanks for taking this on. As part of our SIG intake we need a concise mapping of how customer data flows through Redwood's stack and which downstream subprocessors have custody or access to any PHI/PII. Specifically Clarion needs:

- A subprocessor ownership table (entity, function, regions, legal controls) covering all subprocessors used in the last 12 months.

- Any tokenization/derivative telemetry that leaves our network (e.g., embeddings, analytics).

We have a compliance window — would you be able to deliver a first-pass pack by EOD Wednesday (48 hours)? If not, a short plan + ETA is fine.

We also need the attachments as separate files (XLSX for the subprocessor table recommended).

Thanks,
